Layout.description: An AI-driven platform for learning a foreign language: generated lessons, automatic levelling, and live practice with another learner.

Footer.legalSentence: An academic project. Not a commercial service. Check out our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> and <terms>Terms of Service</terms>.

HomePage.headline: Learn a language with a tutor that adapts to you!
HomePage.intro: ft_transcendence generates lessons, grades your answers, tracks the level it infers from them, and pairs you with another learner for live practice. This page is the skeleton: everything below is wiring, not product.

Lobby.title: Lobby
Lobby.heading: Practice modes
Lobby.friendsDescription: Talk with another learner, each of you writing your own language. The AI translates between you and corrects as you go.
Lobby.chatDescription: Work through a topic with the AI tutor, grounded in the course material.

Onboarding.title: Get started
Onboarding.chooseCourseHeading: What do you want to learn?
Onboarding.chooseCourseIntro: Pick a language and how long you want to practise each day. The pace can be changed later.
Onboarding.chooseLevelIntro: Take the placement test, or set your level yourself if you already know it.
Onboarding.noNewLanguage: No new language to add for now.

levelTile.A0: You are starting from scratch. Your lessons will aim at level A1.
levelTile.A1: You manage simple phrases. Your lessons will aim at level A2.
levelTile.A2: You handle everyday exchanges. Your lessons will aim at level B1.
levelTile.B1: You hold a conversation on familiar topics. Your lessons will aim at level B2.
levelTile.B2: You express yourself comfortably on a range of topics. Your lessons will aim at level C1.
levelTile.C1: You express yourself fluently, including on complex topics. Your lessons will aim at level C2.
levelTile.C2: You have mastered the language. Your lessons will maintain and refine it.
